newsitem.title: FINLAND: Pohjola up sharply for second day.
newsitem.headline: Pohjola up sharply for second day.

text.p: Shares in Finnish insurance group Vakuutusosakeyhtio Pohjola rose sharply for a second day on Friday on sustained interest in Pohjola's life-insurance restructuring plan announced Thursday, brokers said.
At 1520/1320 GMT, Pohjola B traded at 143.10 markka, up 11.10 markka or more than eight percent, in lively 43 million markka turnover.
"This opens up all kinds of interesting prospects," said one broker, referring to the way the restructuring brings to the bourse the value of Pohjola's fast-growing life insurance.
But another broker said the share's rise was better explained by speculation that Pohjola may cancel some of the shares it will buy from its associate Suomi as part of the reshuffle.
"There has been speculation that the number of shares could fall and thereby raise the net asset value of the remaining shares," he said.
Pohjola bucked a weakening trend on the bourse.
